decisions.scenario: Finding a museum and a moderately priced international restaurant

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Please find a museum in town.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Cambridge has many museums. Is there a particular area you prefer?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I do not have a preference. Can you suggest one and give me its address?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Broughton House Gallery has free admission and is in the centre at 98 King Street, postcode CB1 1LN.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thank you. Can you also recommend a moderately priced international restaurant?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The Varsity Restaurant and Bloomsbury Restaurant are both in the centre and serve international food in the moderate price range.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thank you for the information. That will be all.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You are welcome. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Learner

turns.text: Thank you. That is all I needed.

turns.text: I am looking for a train from Cambridge.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Certainly. What is your destination?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: My destination is Norwich.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are many trains. What day and time would you like to travel?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I need to leave on Saturday after 17:00.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There is a train leaving Cambridge at 17:36 and arriving in Norwich at 18:55. Would you like to book it?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: What is the train ID and price?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The train ID is TR4018, and the journey costs 14.08 pounds.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That is everything I needed to know. Thanks.
